'''Maws''' are infested [[blocks]] that act as parasite traps.
{{Item Info
|image1=Maw.png
|id=srparasites:parasitemouth
}}

==''Obtainment''==
Maws can be harvested in surplus from [[Meteor|Meteors]] and from various pitfall trap structures in the [[Parasite Biome]].

==''Usage''==
Maws inflict stacking [[Viral|Viral II]] for ten seconds and [[Corrosion]] for five seconds to any non-parasite mob. Due to their damage output, they can be used as an effective trap block if one manages to survive a Meteor or disarm a Parasite Biome to collect many of them.
